sheets.title: NAVFAC DB-RFP Cover Sheet — Building 340 Replace Closed Circuit Evaporative Cooler
sheets.reading_notes: NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic RFP cover sheet. eProjects WO# 1655654. RFP prepared by NAVFAC PWD Oceana FEAD PM&E PRA211/214. Design Manager David W. Gregory III, P.E. Approved by Christopher B. Morris, P.E. (Design Engineering Branch Manager), signed digitally 2022-06-29. Confirms design-build delivery method.

sheets.title: Table of Contents
sheets.reading_notes: TOC shows Parts 2 (General Requirements), 3 (Statement of Work/Project Program), 4 (Minimum Materials/Engineering/Construction Requirements), 5 (Prescriptive Specifications), and 6 (Attachments including Vicinity Map, Site Map, Reference Documents: ATC System Bldg 340, Energy Conservation Measures Bldg 340, and Equipment Inventory Form). Only first 10 pages of full RFP package were rendered.

sheets.title: Part 2 — General Requirements (cover)
sheets.reading_notes: Section divider for Part 2 General Requirements. Confirms project title 'BUILDING 340 – REPLACE CLOSED CIRCUIT EVAPORATIVE COOLER, NAVAL AIR STATION OCEANA, VIRGINIA BEACH, VIRGINIA'.

sheets.title: Part 2 — General Requirements (pages 1–7 of 28)
sheets.reading_notes: Standard NAVFAC design-build general requirements boilerplate: definitions, accessibility (UFC 1-200-01), warranty (1 year), equipment inventory forms, summary of work (FAR 52.236-9 protection of government property), work restrictions (base access via DBIDS), price and payment procedures (NAVFAC forms, WAWF), administrative requirements (superintendent qualifications). Work hours 0700–1530 Mon–Fri. Security access via DBIDS biometric credentialing required for all contractor personnel. No project-specific dollar amounts stated in these pages.

sheets.title: Damuth-Trane Proposal — DDC Controls (NAS Oceana Bldg 340)
sheets.reading_notes: Proposal from Damuth-Trane (Chesapeake VA) to SYNCON dated August 11, 2022. Scope: modification of existing Trane Tracer DDC Control System, disconnect controls for existing CCEC, provide BACnet controls for new CCEC, standalone water temperature sensor/display, programming by Trane Controls Technician, 1-year labor/materials warranty. Excludes: power wiring, smoke detectors/fire alarm interface, control valve/sensor installation, commissioning. Price not shown.

sheets.title: Site Plan with Annotations — Enlarged Floor Plan Bldg 340
sheets.reading_notes: Shows existing EVAPCO CC-1 name plate (model ESW-102-33H, Virginia Beach serial). Annotated floor plan shows: CC-1 location on exterior pad, mechanical room (166) and training room (164), underground piping to geothermal well field. Handwritten annotations: 'REMOVE FENCE', 'DEMO CONC PAD / NEW CONCRETE PAD', 'REMOVE 18 VITEX 48 LONG'. Existing 400Hz generator (167) visible adjacent. Direct reading CWS temperature sensor location shown. North arrow on plan — confirms exterior pad on NE side of building.

sheets.title: Hercules Fence Proposal — Cooling Tower Enclosure
sheets.reading_notes: Proposal from Hercules Fence (Norfolk VA) to SYNCON dated August 11, 2022. Scope: 50 LF of 7-foot high pressure-treated wood fence enclosure. Exclusions include removal of existing enclosure. Price not shown.

sheets.title: Wyatt & Co. Mechanical/Plumbing Estimate (pages 1–4)
sheets.reading_notes: Estimate from Wyatt & Co. of Virginia (Chesapeake VA) to SYNCON (Tommy Phelps) dated August 11, 2022 for 'B-340, NASO, Cool Tower.' Detailed scope breakdown includes: MECHANICAL DEMO — disconnect/remove existing CC-1 cooler, crane lifts (2 lifts), remove condenser water piping/insulation, demo CWS wall mounted sensor, demo floor drain/trap in mech room 166. PLUMBING DEMO — demo CC-1 make-up water from mech room. PLUMBING NEW WORK — provide/install new trench drain system, chemical shot feeder piping, new CC-1 make-up water system, new drain system to sanitary sewer in mech room 166, 25% glycol (6 units). MECHANICAL NEW WORK — provide EVAPCO CCEC with VFD panel, install CC-1, new VFD panel, new condenser water pipe/fittings/supports, pipe insulation, chemical water treatment with Neptune filter feeder, heat tracing on piping, Trane DDC controls, assist TABs contractor. Rate/Amount columns are blank — price data not captured.

sheets.title: Power Electric Company Proposal — Electrical
sheets.reading_notes: Proposal from Power Electric Company (Chesapeake VA, division of CHAMPCO Inc.) to SYNCON dated August 11, 2022. Scope: lockout/tagout existing chiller circuits, disconnect and remove conduit/wire back to source, remove existing breaker; provide new 40A circuit from panelboard in RM 165 to new CC-1 VFD control panel; provide 60A 3PH NEMA 4X fused disconnect at 40A; install 60/3 breaker in panelboard in RM 165; remove/reinstall/re-lamp 6 mechanical room lighting fixtures; demolish GFCI receptacle; reuse existing breaker and provide conduit/wire to new GFCI receptacle. Excludes: painting, bond, HVAC controls conduit, control panel and VFD. Price not shown.

sheets.title: RWH Mechanical Sales Quotation — EVAPCO Closed Circuit Cooler and VFD Panel
sheets.reading_notes: Equipment quotation from RWH Mechanical Sales (Norfolk VA) dated August 11, 2022. One (1) EVAPCO ESW4 9-43G18-SP-R induced draft closed circuit cooler: 524.8 GPM, 25% propylene glycol, EWT 100F/LWT 90F at 80F WB, coil pressure drop 2.3 PSI, all 304 stainless steel construction, two 5 HP inverter-duty fan motors, vibration switch, two 6 kW sump heaters, 1 x 7.5 HP sump pump, electronic water level control, external service platform with ladder, motor davit, low sound fan. Approx dimensions 18' x 8.5' x 18.5' high. Ships in 2 sections, heaviest section 11,620 lbs. One (1) Stainless Steel NEMA 4X VFD panel. Lead time ~12 weeks. Price field redacted ('Your Cost... Freight Allowed --- $').

sheets.title: EVAPCO Technical Data Sheet — ESW4 9-43G18-SP-R Closed Circuit Cooler
sheets.reading_notes: EVAPCO factory technical data sheet for ESW4 9-43G18-SP-R. Confirms: Flow 524.8 GPM, fluid 25% propylene glycol, EWT 100F/LWT 90F/WB 80F, required capacity 2,523.95 MBH (168.26 tons). Physical data: overall dimensions 8'-5.5" W x 18'-0" L x 18'-5.75" H, operating weight 26,450 lbs, shipping weight 18,420 lbs, heaviest section 11,617 lbs. Fan data: 2 fans, 2 motors, 5 HP each (10 HP total nameplate). Pump: 1 pump, 7.5 HP. IBC structural design certified, Seismic (Sps) up to 1.6g, Wind up to 119 psf. Sound data (low sound fan) approximately 78–80 dBA at 5'. Ships in 2 sections. CTI certified.

sheets.title: EVAPCO Shop Drawing — ESW4 9-43G18-SP-R Unit Drawing (Plan/Elevation/Coil Connections)
sheets.reading_notes: EVAPCO factory drawing SLWX40918-DA. Overall unit dimensions confirmed: 8'-5.5" W x 18'-0" L x 18'-5.75" H. Coil connections at Faces B & D (2x 4" BFW fluid in, 2x 4" BFW fluid out). Drain/makeup connections shown. Unit weight on drawing: 26,450 lbs operating, 18,360+ lbs shipping. Two shipping sections. Note: drawing is dated 7/26/2022.

sheets.title: EVAPCO Shop Drawing — Steel Support Configuration
sheets.reading_notes: EVAPCO factory drawing SLWX40918-DA showing steel beam support configuration. Plan view and end view of mounting hole layout. Dimension 19'-0" typical between support beams. Mounting holes and unit outline shown. Factory-recommended steel support guidance; actual support design by BFA per BOD structural section.

sheets.title: EVAPCO Shop Drawings — Electric Water Level Control, Vibration Switch Wiring
sheets.reading_notes: Factory drawings for make-up water level control assembly (standpipe, Y-strainer, electric make-up valve) and vibration switch single-speed wiring diagram. Standard equipment accessories.

sheets.title: EVAPCO Shop Drawings — Heater Location, 3-Phase Heater Wiring, External Service Platform, Fan Motor Space Heaters
sheets.reading_notes: Factory heater location drawing (HLWX409VE-DA): two immersion heaters (2x 6 kW) in basin. 3-phase heater wiring diagram (2 heaters, 460V/3/60). External service platform drawing (PLWX40918-DB): H-dimension 10'-3" to 14'-9" range across model family; for ESW4-9-43G18, service platform H ~ 14'-2". Removable davit drawing showing fan/motor removal rigging. Fan motor space heater wiring (120V, <2 amps). All standard factory drawings.

sheets.title: EVAPCO Sound Data Sheet and Certificate of Sound Compliance
sheets.reading_notes: Full-speed sound data for ESW4 9-43G18-SP-R with Low Sound Fan option. Motor: 5 HP, 2 motors, full speed. Sound pressure levels (Calc dBA at 5 ft): End 77, Motor Side 79, Opp End 77, Opp Mtr Side 78, Top 80. Overall Calc dBA at 5': ~80 dBA (top face). CTI ATC-128 Certificate of Compliance for independent sound validation.

sheets.title: VFD Control Panel Drawings — Cooling Tower Control Panel (NEMA 4X Stainless, 460V 3PH)
sheets.reading_notes: Control panel drawings from Associated Starters & Controls (Norfolk VA). Title: 'COOLING TOWER CONTROL PANEL ENCLOSURE – 460V – 3PH'. NEMA 4X, 36"x30"x12" stainless steel enclosure. Connected load: 40.1 AMPS; max run load: 25A; HCR: 60A; MCP: 31.3A. Includes VFD for fan motors (WEG CFV11), motor contactors for Fan 1, Fan 2, spray pump, plus basin heaters (2x 6kW). Control logic includes hand/off/auto for fan and spray pump, vibration switch interlock, thermostat condensation control, water level controls (high/low alarm, EVLC valve), basin heater control. Two wiring schematics pages. Designed/approved 07/29/2022.

gross_square_footage.notes: Not applicable — mechanical equipment replacement project, not a building with a measurable gross SF. Site LOD is approximately 750 SF per BOD Civil.

floor_count.notes: Not applicable — single exterior mechanical equipment pad replacement plus interior mechanical room work.

New VFD panel (NEMA 4X stainless, 460V 3PH, 40.1A connected load) for cooler fan and pump control
DDC integration: modification of existing Trane Tracer control system via BACnet
New chemical water treatment with Neptune filter feeder and glycol system (25% propylene glycol, 6 units)
New 12"x36" trench drain in mechanical equipment room (Room 166)
electrical: New 40A circuit from panelboard 'LA' or 'HC' in Room 165 to new CC-1 VFD control panel
New 60/3 breaker installed in panelboard RM 165
Remove/reinstall/re-lamp 6 mechanical room fluorescent lighting fixtures
New GFCI receptacle adjacent to 60A disconnect
Existing building power: 480Y/277V, 3-phase, 4-wire and 208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire in Room 165
plumbing: New trench drain system (12"x36") in mechanical room 166 connecting to sanitary sewer
Chemical shot feeder piping for water treatment

structural_notes: New 2'-6" thick reinforced concrete mat foundation (#6 at 12" OC top, #8 at 12" OC bottom)
Two-level W12 steel beam support frame raising cooler bottom to +2'-0" above foundation
3/4" diameter anchor bolts for lateral (wind and seismic) resistance
1" thick steel bearing plates under lower W12 beams
Design loads: DL 26,450 lbs (cooler) + 1,020 lbs (platform); wind 124 MPH (Vult), seismic Sms=0.124g
Special inspections by Broyles and Associates, P.C.
Foundation setback 3 ft from existing building to avoid imposing load on existing foundations
civil_site_notes: LOD approximately 750 SF on NE side of Building 340
Demolition of existing concrete pad, concrete walk pavement, and wood fence/gate
New concrete utility pad/foundation (elevated 6" above surrounding grade)
New fence enclosure (50 LF, 7-ft pressure-treated wood per Hercules Fence proposal)
Bermuda grass sod for disturbed areas
Silt fence ESC measures; no DEQ permit required (<10,000 SF disturbance)
No additional impervious surface >5,000 SF; no LID calculations required
